Priya: Ok team — followup from postmortem on INC-2026-45. Collecting action items for DR/regional failover. I'll paste the list I'm tracking. Please ack and add owners.
Samir: ack. can you add a column for test cadence?
Liam: I'll take multi-region routing policy review. target EOD Fri 2026-04-10.
Priya: Current owners I'm proposing: Liam — routing policy audit; Devon — cross-region backup verify; Samir — restore runbook updates; Maria — DR tabletop scheduling. Add if you want different.
Devon: noted — what's the scope for 'backup verify' (snapshots vs object replication)?
Priya: snapshots + cross-region replication checks. runbook should include the basic restore smoke: `rclone ls s3://redwood-backups --region us-west-2` and a section showing promote steps for replicas.
Samir: I'll draft runbook changes, then post PR to ops-runbooks repo. ETA Tue 2026-04-07.
Maria: I'll schedule a 2-hour tabletop week of Apr 13-17. Prefer Apr 15. Triage leads? @Liam @Samir
Liam: I can be triage lead for routing. :white_check_mark:
Devon: will own restore exercises. preliminary smoke checklist: 1) failover route enabled, 2) promote replica, 3) validate tokens/certs, 4) basic traffic sanity.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-45 postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/pm/inc-2026-45 — owners synced to tracker.
Samir: created tracker doc: https://docs.google.com/drive/xxx — I added columns: owner, ETA, status, test_date, notes.
Priya: Good. We need a weekly sync until all items closed. I'll run a standing Friday 9am PT check-in. Recurring calendar invite coming.
Liam: quick note — add fallback policy in routing: prefer region with healthy KV-cache, fallback to compatible quantized model pool. I'll sketch the policy and post to the doc.
Devon: FYI I'm doing a restore from last successful snapshot in staging tomorrow and will post logs + time-to-restore metrics.
Samir: thx. once devon posts logs i'll create remediation PRs and assign reviewers.
Priya: Deadline summary (copied to tracker): routing audit (Liam) — 2026-04-10; runbook updates (Samir) — 2026-04-07; backup verify (Devon) — 2026-04-12; tabletop (Maria) — scheduled 2026-04-15. Ping me if timeline slips.
Maria: acked :thumbsup:
Liam: ack :thumbsup:
Devon: ack
Priya: closing the thread — please update the tracker doc instead of posting progress here. i'll post a short weekly status update in #incidents. :lock:
